# Vendored Markdown editor

- Project: https://github.com/nodes-app/swift-markdown-engine
- Revision: `a832ddc5a1d72aa1c0d11dc2d4dc97ac6c5ecddb`
- Upstream license: Apache License 2.0, in `MarkdownEngine-LICENSE`
- Scope: `Sources/MarkdownEngine` only; optional syntax-highlighting and LaTeX products are not included.

The engine is built into Weft's macOS app target so the app's existing direct Swift compiler build can use it without fetching dependencies at build time.
